title: A familiar route into chat
summary:
Chat became easier to plug into, the model menu grew, and community projects moved closer to the front door.

The text API added OpenAI-compatible POST `/v1/chat/completions` with streaming and non-streaming responses. Text requests from the same IP are now spaced 6 seconds apart instead of 12, reducing time spent waiting between requests.

Gemini Flash Lite, Gemini Thinking, DeepSeek, Mistral Small 24B, Pixtral 12B, and Llama Vision expanded the text and image-chat options. `openai-reasoning` moved to o3-mini, `phi` moved to Phi-4 Instruct, and DeepSeek’s response limit doubled to 8,192 tokens. System instructions and token defaults also got more careful handling for models with different requirements.

Short image prompts are no longer automatically enhanced. Image generation gained a fallback when Cloudflare Flux fails; after an initial SDXL fallback, the route was changed to ComfyUI. Image requests with `private=true` are now mapped to `nofeed` for feed handling, and Unity’s image guidance now points to flux.

The project directory gained apps, tools, a Discord bot, and a TypeScript Node.js client, spanning image generation, stories, chat, speech, and food-photo analysis. Projects moved ahead of Integrations on the homepage, with a new “For Teens 🚀” tab drawn from featured projects. The submission form now requires a project URL.
